purpose: Review a finite Campaign135 catalog against all 151 complete logical definitions and frozen terminal histories, reject exposed operator refreshes before values, and admit only a genuinely independent three-session mechanism.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_running_close_extreme_recency_balance_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.proposed_definition: Across the full 240-close path, average the age since the latest running low minus the age since the latest running high, with exact ties refreshing the relevant record age.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign083 rejected both close-frontier last-innovation recency and signed high-versus-low frontier imbalance before values. Averaging record ages over all clocks changes the summary functional but recombines those two exposed choices; it is not a new information domain and may not be rescued by a later uniqueness result.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_cross_sectional_cumulative_return_rank_occupancy_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.source: accepted one-minute close snapshot plus same-position peers
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign063 explicitly rejected cross-sectional percentile ranks, bucket persistence and alternate peer-state operators before freezing its standardized state-mobility definition; its terminal state forbids changing the peer statistic, formula or transform. Replacing return-state mobility with average cumulative-return rank occupancy would reopen that frozen peer-construction search.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_full_session_median_close_crossing_or_recross_count
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Candidate49 is the isolated causal cumulative-VWAP crossing mechanism, while Campaign121 froze out passage count, recross count and alternate reference levels before values. Changing the anchor to the completed-session median is a reference substitution inside the same crossing family.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_amount_or_range_gini_hhi_top_share_refresh
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.source: accepted one-minute amount or high-low snapshot
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Amount participation entropy and intrabar range participation entropy already consume unordered concentration; Campaign011 and Campaign128 explicitly reject Gini, Herfindahl, top-share and related dispersion substitutes.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: complete_library_robust_vote_trimmed_mean_or_cluster_refresh
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign044, Campaign101, Campaign102, Campaign103 and Campaign132-134 already consume deterministic consensus, lower-tail consensus, supervised weights, temporal breadth, nonlinear fits and correlation components. A trimmed vote, threshold or reclustering rule after those outcomes is a prohibited exposed-library refresh.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: daily_opening_gap_or_zero_volume_resumption_proxy
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The prior-close opening-gap branch is permanently invalid under the historical 09:30 semantics, and Campaign113 already terminalized suspension/resumption capacity. Inferring either state from daily gaps or zero-volume rows would downgrade frozen source semantics rather than add a new point-in-time source.

selection.reason: Each proposal is an explicit prevalue rejection, a terminal-family operator or reference refresh, a source-semantic downgrade, or a post-exposure complete-library recombination.

decision.next_campaign_requirement: Begin Campaign136 only from a genuinely new prevalue mechanism or a separately accepted point-in-time source; preserve every Campaign135 rejection, the exact 151-definition/140-comparator orders, and Candidate49 as the sole prospective ledger.
